name: lv_obj_update_layout

ownership.argument: Borrowed live page-owned LVGL object/event/input device; output coordinate buffer borrowed for call; no retention.

provenance.source: Walks screen layout dirty flags and recomputes native geometry; exact helper called by native scroll_to. Startup 0xc0c0ac8 copies [0x2c10d440,0x2c18d940) to PSRAM 0x3c000000, executable alias 0x1c000000; load address 0xc139ba0 maps to runtime 0x1c02c760, callable 0x1c02c761. Native veneers 0xc588090 and 0x002c2fc0 independently target 0x1c02c761; absolute scroll_to calls it at 0x1c02ddf2.

notes: Target-private native UI host only. Static recovery does not grant public callable approval or device verification.
